latest_release.body:
## Dear ImGui v1.93.1 🔧 

✋ **Reading the changelog is a good way to keep up to date with whaat Dear ImGui has to offer**, and will give you ideas of some features that you've been ignoring until now!
📣 If you are browsing multiple releases: click version number above to display full release note contents, otherwise it is badly clipped by GitHub!

---

Links: [Homepage](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) - [Release notes](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases) - [FAQ](https://www.dearimgui.com/faq) - [Issues, Q&A](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/issues). Also see our [Wiki](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki) with sections such as..
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Getting-Started) (~25 lines in an existing app)
- [Useful Extensions/Widgets](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Useful-Extensions)
- [Software using Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Software-using-Dear-ImGui)
- [Language Bindings & Engine Backends](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Bindings) 
- and more! 👌

**Dear ImGui is funded by your contributions and absolutely needs them to sustain and grow**. We can invoice and accommodate to many situations. If your company uses Dear ImGui, please reach out. See [Funding page](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Funding). **Did you know? If you need an excuse to pay, you may buy licenses for [Test Engine](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui_test_engine) and buy hours of support (and cough not use them all) and that will contribute to fund Dear ImGui.**

❤️ Thanks to sponsors ❤️ 

- **[BeamNG](https://www.beamng.com)** / **[G3Dvu](https://www.g3dvu.com/)** / **[OTOY](https://home.otoy.com/)** / **[Riot Games](https://www.riotgames.com)** / **[Scorewarrior](https://scorewarrior.com)** / **[Supercell](https://supercell.com/)** / [Asobo Studio](https://www.asobostudio.com) / [Artifex Mundi](https://www.artifexmundi.com/) / [ID Software](https://www.idsoftware.com) / [Lucid Games](https://www.lucidgames.co.uk/) / [Mobigame](https://www.mobigame.net/) / [Passtech Games](https://www.passtechgames.com/) / [Planestate Software](https://www.plane9.com/) / [River End Games](https://riverendgames.com/) / [RocketWerkz](https://rocketwerkz.com/) / [SCS Software](https://www.scssoft.com/) / [Sofistik](https://www.sofistik.com/en/company/about-us) / [Thatgamecompany](https://thatgamecompany.com) / [Tuxedo Labs](https://www.tuxedolabs.com/) / [Valve](https://www.valvesoftware.com/en/) / [Vector Unit](https://www.vectorunit.com/) / [Yacht Club Games](https://www.yachtclubgames.com/)🐭 

As well as various paid/corporate licenses to [imgui_test_engine](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui_test_engine) supporting the project.

----

## Changes in v1.93.1 (since [v1.93.0](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/v1.93.0))

This is a general maintenance release.

🆘 [v1.93.0](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/v1.93.0) has a much reworked `ImDrawList` system.
🆘 [v1.92.8](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/v1.92.8) has a signature change for the trailing optional parameters of `ImDrawList::AddRect()`, `AddPolyline()`, `PathStroke()`. C++ users should be notified at compile-time, but languages without type-checking may only be notified at runtime. Read [v1.92.8](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/v1.92.8) if using non a C++ language. Consider enabling `IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS` from time to time to get rid of obsolete calls.

----

### Breaking Changes

Autumn cleanup of stuff marked obsolete more than two years ago:

- Commented out legacy names/functions which were obsoleted in 1.90.7 (May 2024);
  - `ImGuiMod_Shortcut`                    --> `ImGuiMod_Ctrl` (since 1.90.7 it maps to Cmd on macOS)
- Commented out legacy names/functions which were obsoleted in 1.90.9 (July 2024);
  - `ImGuiCol_TabActive`                   --> `ImGuiCol_TabSelected`
  - `ImGuiCol_TabUnfocused`                --> `ImGuiCol_TabDimmed`
